name: mbind
synopsis: long mbind(void *addr, unsigned long len, int mode, const unsigned long *nodemask, unsigned long maxnode, unsigned int flags);
description: The mbind() system call sets the NUMA memory policy for a specified memory range, defining from which nodes memory is allocated. It applies to new page allocations in that range and can be influenced by flags for behavior like moving existing pages.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Starting address of the memory range

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the memory range in bytes

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Policy mode, such as MPOL_DEFAULT, MPOL_BIND, etc.

parameters.name: nodemask
parameters.description: Pointer to a bit mask specifying the nodes

parameters.name: maxnode
parameters.description: Maximum node number in the nodemask

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify policy behavior, such as MPOL_MF_MOVE

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Part or all of the memory range specified by nodemask and maxnode is inaccessible, or there is an unmapped hole in the range specified by addr and len
Invalid value for flags or mode; addr + len is less than addr; addr is not page-aligned; or other invalid conditions like empty nodemask for certain modes
MPOL_MF_STRICT was specified and an existing page violates the policy, or MPOL_MF_MOVE failed to relocate pages
The caller lacks CAP_SYS_NICE privilege for MPOL_MF_MOVE_ALL
